relationships.relationship: Pickup data is loaded within the currently selected service and facility context.
relationships.evidence: The page displayed two context comboboxes, and loading Pickups requested facility and hub data.

relationships.relationship: Pickups are associated with clients and can be filtered by client on the map.
relationships.evidence: The main page requested a client list, the map exposed Choose Client, and map pickup objects contained a client identifier.

relationships.relationship: A pickup can be assigned to a driver.
relationships.evidence: The main table includes Driver and assignment-state filters; pickup requests support assigned/unassigned states, and map requests include driver_id.

relationships.relationship: Pickups or pickup schedules may be associated with a group.
relationships.evidence: The main table includes Group, the schedule view includes Group and Manage Groups, and APIs expose pickup_group_id.

relationships.relationship: A pharmacy/client may have pickup time windows configured per weekday.
relationships.evidence: The schedule table contains pharmacy, address, group, and Monday-through-Sunday columns; the schedule API returns client_id, week_day_num, start_time, and end_time.

relationships.relationship: Pickup records with coordinates can be represented on the pickup map.
relationships.evidence: The map endpoint returned pickup records containing latitude and longitude fields.

The observed date showed zero pickups in every displayed status category.

observedFacts.evidence: Live interaction followed by the observed request body.

observedFacts.fact: The pickup map is a related child route and supports client selection and standard map controls.
The pickup schedule is a related child route showing pharmacy schedules by weekday.

uncertainties: The behavior and fields of New Pickup were not inspected because entering that workflow could lead to business-data mutation.
The behavior of Add and Manage Groups on the schedule page was not inspected because these controls may change configuration.
CSV output shape was not verified because the export was not downloaded.
Row-level actions and empty-state selection behavior could not be verified for the observed date because the table contained no pickup rows.
The date picker calendar internals were not fully exposed in the accessibility snapshot.
Map marker interactions were not exercised, and no customer or patient values from map responses were retained.
Context behavior in service areas or facilities other than the currently selected Hawaii context was not tested.
result.summary: ADM Pickups is a context-sensitive activity table at /clients/pickups with date/status/search filtering, sorting, pagination, CSV and refresh controls. It links to a client-filterable pickup map and a weekly pharmacy pickup schedule. Live requests confirmed count, list, map, driver, client, facility/hub, and schedule/group data sources. No business data was mutated.
